description: Download a Sales and Trends report (units, installs, proceeds by territory/device) as rows. Needs the vendor number; data for a day usually appears the next day. reportSubType and version must suit the reportType (SALES uses SUMMARY); Apple names the accepted values in its error.

maxRows.description: Rows to return in the response; the full report goes to outputPath

outputPath.description: Save the full decompressed report to this file

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at outputPath

reportDate.description: Omit for the latest available report

version.description: Report format version, e.g. 1_1; Apple names the accepted versions in its error if this is wrong

name: apple_get_sales_report
